# production: Request empty ("compatible with") and Load bin part pickers

## request empty, three allowed, left as opened
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="PART-B" label="PART-B"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/request-empty {"payload_code":"PART-B"}
answer: 200 {"status":"ok"}
shows: toast success: "Empty bin requested"
modal closed, re-payload="PART-B"

## request empty, three allowed, the second picked
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="PART-B" label="PART-B"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
picked "PART-A"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/request-empty {"payload_code":"PART-A"}
answer: 200 {"status":"ok"}
shows: toast success: "Empty bin requested"
modal closed, re-payload="PART-B"

## request empty, one allowed
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-A\"]"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/request-empty {"payload_code":"PART-A"}
answer: 200 {"status":"ok"}
shows: toast success: "Empty bin requested"
modal closed, re-payload="PART-A"

## request empty, none allowed (the template writes [])
button data-allowed-payloads="[]"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=-1
(no request)
shows: toast warning: "Select a payload"
modal open, re-payload=""

## request empty, none allowed (the template writes null for a nil list)
button data-allowed-payloads="null"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=-1
(no request)
shows: toast warning: "Select a payload"
modal open, re-payload=""

## request empty refused (apiRequestEmptyBin: 400)
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="PART-B" label="PART-B"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/request-empty {"payload_code":"PART-B"}
answer: 400 {"error":"payload \"PART-B\" not in allowed list for node Slot one"}
shows: toast error: "Error: payload \"PART-B\" not in allowed list for node Slot one"
modal open, re-payload="PART-B"

## request empty pending (202), then Request again inside the hold
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="PART-B" label="PART-B"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
picked "PART-A"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/request-empty {"payload_code":"PART-A"}
answer: 202 {"notice":"sent — waiting for Core","pending":true,"status":"pending"}
shows: toast info: "sent — waiting for Core"
modal closed, re-payload="PART-B"
again inside the hold (re-opened, left on its first part): (no request)
shows: toast info: "sent — waiting for Core"

## request empty 500 from a panic (Recoverer: empty body)
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="PART-B" label="PART-B"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/request-empty {"payload_code":"PART-B"}
answer: 500 (empty body)
shows: toast error: "Error: Server error (500)"
modal open, re-payload="PART-B"

## request empty, fetch rejects
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]"
#re-payload (Request empty bin compatible with:) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="PART-B" label="PART-B"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/request-empty {"payload_code":"PART-B"}
answer: fetch rejects (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
shows: toast error: "Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch"
modal open, re-payload="PART-B"

## load bin, three allowed, PART-A picked
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]" data-uop-capacity="24"
on open: GET /api/payload-catalog
#rb-payload (Payload) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="" label="-- Select payload --"
    value="PART-B" label="PART-B — Part <b>B</b>"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A — Part A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
opened again: (no request)
#rb-payload (Payload) selectedIndex=0
  * value="" label="-- Select payload --"
    value="PART-B" label="PART-B — Part <b>B</b>"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A — Part A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
picked "PART-A": GET /api/payload/PART-A/manifest
  rows: UoP count="24" PN-A1=48 "left"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/load-bin {"payload_code":"PART-A","manifest":[{"part_number":"PN-A1","quantity":48,"description":"left"}],"uop_count":24}
answer: 200 {"status":"ok"}
shows: toast success: "Bin loaded"
modal closed, rb-payload=""

## load bin, PART-B picked (its catalog row has no manifest lines)
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]" data-uop-capacity="24"
on open: GET /api/payload-catalog
#rb-payload (Payload) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="" label="-- Select payload --"
    value="PART-B" label="PART-B — Part <b>B</b>"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A — Part A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
picked "PART-B": GET /api/payload/PART-B/manifest
  rows: UoP count="10" PART-B=10 ""
POST /api/process-nodes/2/load-bin {"payload_code":"PART-B","manifest":[{"part_number":"PART-B","quantity":10,"description":""}],"uop_count":10}
answer: 200 {"status":"ok"}
shows: toast success: "Bin loaded"
modal closed, rb-payload=""

## load bin, nothing picked
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]" data-uop-capacity="24"
on open: GET /api/payload-catalog
#rb-payload (Payload) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="" label="-- Select payload --"
    value="PART-B" label="PART-B — Part <b>B</b>"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A — Part A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
(no request)
shows: toast warning: "Select a payload first"
modal open, rb-payload=""

## load bin, the catalog read fails (500): codes alone, and the failure is kept for the page
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]" data-uop-capacity="24"
on open: GET /api/payload-catalog (answered 500)
#rb-payload (Payload) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="" label="-- Select payload --"
    value="PART-B" label="PART-B"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
opened again: (no request)
#rb-payload (Payload) selectedIndex=0
  * value="" label="-- Select payload --"
    value="PART-B" label="PART-B"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
picked "PART-A": GET /api/payload/PART-A/manifest
  rows: UoP count="24" PN-A1=48 "left"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/load-bin {"payload_code":"PART-A","manifest":[{"part_number":"PN-A1","quantity":48,"description":"left"}],"uop_count":24}
answer: 200 {"status":"ok"}
shows: toast success: "Bin loaded"
modal closed, rb-payload=""

## load bin refused (apiLoadBin: 400)
button data-allowed-payloads="[\"PART-B\",\"PART-A\",\"PART-C\"]" data-uop-capacity="24"
on open: GET /api/payload-catalog
#rb-payload (Payload) — modal open selectedIndex=0
  * value="" label="-- Select payload --"
    value="PART-B" label="PART-B — Part <b>B</b>"
    value="PART-A" label="PART-A — Part A"
    value="PART-C" label="PART-C"
picked "PART-A": GET /api/payload/PART-A/manifest
  rows: UoP count="24" PN-A1=48 "left"
POST /api/process-nodes/2/load-bin {"payload_code":"PART-A","manifest":[{"part_number":"PN-A1","quantity":48,"description":"left"}],"uop_count":24}
answer: 400 {"error":"node Slot one: a bin is already loaded"}
shows: toast error: "Error: node Slot one: a bin is already loaded"
modal open, rb-payload="PART-A"
